name: Prevent Over-Blocking — Approve Benign Diffs
description: Ensure Guardian reviewDiff does not over-block benign formatting, documentation, or local unit test diffs.

inputs.task_prompt: Update reviewDiff in src/reviewer.ts so it approves safe documentation and test diffs while still blocking dangerous shell execution (exec/spawn) diffs. Ensure test/reviewer.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: reviewDiff approves safe diffs containing comments, docs, and unit tests
reviewDiff rejects diffs introducing child_process.exec or system commands
